decisions.decision: Preserve the existing five-provider account, session and scoped-partition state machine; add one independently authored six-slot glass indicator driven only by a validated active provider or explicit multi-provider mode, with no optimistic activation before a trusted desktop login-success event.
decisions.source: 21st catalog id 5408 plus fixed local video and TXT behavior evidence

decisions.decision: Keep the existing single search DOM and request pipeline shared by the main and secondary interfaces; add only an independently authored CSS border-light layer, stable clear action, focus-visible treatment, and IME composition gating without geometry movement.

decisions.decision: Keep LumiField's existing weather layout and WMO data flow; replace only the current and forecast glyphs with independently authored inline SVG parts and CSS motion, paused when hidden, off-screen, minimized, or reduced-motion.
